Test fixture had to be fixed (endpoint /api/clubs/mine → /api/clubs, and owner detection via is_owner) before running — this is a test-only change. minor.issue: Open Library returns title 'George Orwell — 1984' (438 p, 1993) instead of 'Le Petit Prince'. Not a code bug (OL catalog quirk for this ISBN edition), but end-user will be surprised. Consider preferring the ISBN's expected Gallimard-Folio record or falling back to Google when OL title looks unrelated.

Bogus ISBN returns 200 with an unrelated random book (Rómulo Maccio) instead of 404 — Open Library serves a loose match. Suggest server-side ISBN checksum validation (EAN-13 check digit) before hitting OL to force 404 on syntactically-invalid ISBNs.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate testID 'btn-add-book' — used both on library screen (open add) and on add screen confirm CTA ('Ajouter à ma bibliothèque'). Causes Playwright resolvedTo 2 elements. Recommend renaming confirm CTA to testID 'btn-add-book-confirm'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/library.tsx:89 and /app/frontend/app/book/add.tsx:211

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/books/search fallback chain is correct: try Google Books (fr, maxResults=8) → if 0 results OR exception, fallback to openlibrary.org/search.json (lang=fr, limit=8). Verified live: 8/8 covers returned for 'alchimiste' and 'petit prince' with Google returning 429. Good defensive design.

conftest fixture uses /api/clubs/mine which does not exist (endpoint is GET /api/clubs). Fixed test fixture to use the correct endpoint and is_owner flag from the response. Server code is fine — test file only was buggy.

server.py:1012 _compose_recap uses safe string formatting via f-strings + pseudo lookups (no user-supplied templates), so the earlier 'raw {placeholder}' risk is addressed at code level. Confirmed at runtime that recap text contains resolved pseudos ('Léa — 90 p.') and no raw braces.

rca_of_issue: RCA of original user bug: Google Books v1 daily public quota exhausted in this container → HTTP 429 with 0 items. AddBook.tsx debounced search called /api/books/search which returned {results: []}, so results list stayed empty and users saw nothing. Fix already implemented by main agent: /api/books/search now cascades to openlibrary.org/search.json when Google returns 0 items or throws. Live verification: curl on preview URL returns 8 results (source=openlibrary) with cover URLs pointing to covers.openlibrary.org. UI renders these results with covers, titles, authors, years, tap adds book. Full add flow validated end-to-end.
